models.notes: Arabic-STT best-task06: task-arithmetic merge run6b + 0.6 x (run10 - run6b) + 0.6 x (avg - run6b), avg the 0.5/0.5 average of run6b-soup70-sip-v5 and sip-v5-grpo1, no further training (merge weights picked on the Audioluna calls); weights gated on the Hub. Every parent carries run 5's in-domain train rows (MGB-3 train and the 20 leaked FLEURS ar_eg test sentences included); sip-v5 adds an MGB-2 part of kejue-voice, sip-v5-grpo1 EdAcc and Earnings-22 (English); English: the train splits of LibriSpeech, Common Voice 17, VoxPopuli, AMI and GigaSpeech, EdAcc's dev split and the whole Earnings-22 corpus (every earnings22 test row here included)

Arabic-STT best-grpo2: task06 + 0.3 x (run20 - task06), then GRPO (LoRA r 16, merged; 935 steps) on human-annotated Arabic customer-service call segments, English call-centre clips, quiet short answers under a louder turn, joined multi-turn pieces and windows without speech; weights gated on the Hub. Carries its parents' in-domain train rows (run 5's, MGB-3 train and the 20 leaked FLEURS ar_eg test sentences included); English: the train splits of LibriSpeech, Common Voice 17, VoxPopuli, AMI and GigaSpeech, EdAcc's dev split and the whole Earnings-22 corpus (every earnings22 test row here included), SPGISpeech
